caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass pitcher, narrow at the base with a rounded foot, widening as it rises to the spout. The pitcher has a hexagonal handle attached to the upper side and a prominent pouring spout opposite the handle. The glass surface features engraved designs: along the side of the pitcher, there is a depiction of a bird perched on a branch, with leaves and additional branches forming part of the scene. These decorations are clearly visible both on the main perspective view and the partial side view below, which also shows the handle attached at a distinct angle. The upper rim of the pitcher is decorated with horizontal lines encircling it, and similar lines are seen near the base. The drawing is executed primarily in shades of gray on a plain, off-white background, with some faint yellowish discoloration present near the handle area. The name "Geo. R. Yanosko" appears in small, capitalized letters beneath the lower drawing.
title: Cream Pitcher
